node.speaker: Lady Sophia
node.text: The time has come. The Deep Ones have\nrisen, we have their location

node.speaker: Lady Sophia
node.text: If you succeed we you will be heros,\nand will be paid as agreed

node.speaker: Lady Sophia
node.text: Whatever keeps you motivated I guess

node.speaker: Lady Sophia
node.text: Good luck, and don't fail. Some factions already changed sides

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Welcome, traveler. You look weary.\nCan I help you?

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Bedrooms and bar open all night.\nSome rest will get you healthy

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Rent a room and maybe I'll come by...

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Safe travels.

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Anything else??

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Welcome, traveler.Anything I\ncan do for you?

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Food or resting, everything at a cost

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Watch your mouth or rip\nyour skull open

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Get lost, then.

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Anything else??

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Oooh, a new visit! Come in

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Oh my feathers! I'll take\ncare of you in a second

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: We the bird tribe have lived in peace\nfor centuries now. Collecting knowledge

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Safe travels.

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Anything else??

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: I sense a dark energy in the air\nAre you here to pray?

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: In that case I'll get a bed for you.\nMaybe some food?

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: You won't be saying all that\nwhen the serpent takes you

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Safe travels.

node.speaker: Innkeeper
node.text: Anything else??
